استسقين (form X)
# اِسْتَسْقَيْنَ (istasqayna) /is.tas.qaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
# اُسْتُسْقِينَ (ustusqīna) /us.tus.qiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
# اِسْتَسْقِينَ (istasqīna) /is.tas.qiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَسْقَى (istasqā)
